dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interlocking light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped ring patterns with jagged perimeters; sharp high-contrast transitions from dark background to thin light boundary lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid pixel clusters; small, scattered high-intensity pixel groups are visible primarily near the ventral transition and posterior flipper attachment.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A dominant cluster of three large annuli on the upper mid-section forms an obtuse triangle; a secondary pair of smaller annuli near the posterior forms a vertical axis relative to the body orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive vertical striations on the tail flipper with a gradient shift to darker pigmentation at the distal edges.
